# Kate Solmara

> Kate Solmara (pronounced soul-MAR-uh) is an Arizona-based independent singer-songwriter making warm, emotionally honest indie folk-pop. Her debut single "Ease" was released July 24, 2026.

## Music
- "Ease" (2026), indie folk-pop. Written by Katie Kness and Adam Lamb, produced by Adam Lamb, guitar by Dylan Elliott. Published by Kate Solmara (ASCAP). ISRC QT6EA2644595, UPC 882518335764. Clean.
- Listen: [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/4dL2Sv9Ds2yweuXFF7PB9Z), [Apple Music](https://music.apple.com/us/song/ease/6783796053), [Bandcamp](https://katesolmara.bandcamp.com/track/ease)
